packageRules.description: Forgejo majors: one PR per major with the upstream backup, queue-flush, and doctor steps
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Forgejo Upgrade**: Read the [Forgejo release notes](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases) and, for a chart major, the chart README's *Upgrading* section. Upstream allows skipping versions; before a major, take a CNPG on-demand `Backup` and run `forgejo manager flush-queues`, and after the sync run `forgejo doctor check --all` (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#9-upstream-upgrade-procedures)).

packageRules.description: Home Assistant: the seeded .storage/http must follow the HTTP store format
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Home Assistant Upgrade**: Read the backward-incompatible changes of every release crossed. The bootstrap init container seeds `.storage/http` in the HTTP store's format: when `homeassistant/components/http/config.py` changes its storage version or schema, update the seed in this PR (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#9-upstream-upgrade-procedures)).

packageRules.description: Immich: one PR per major with a breaking-change review reminder
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Immich Upgrade**: Review the [Immich release notes](https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases) for breaking changes and the supported VectorChord range. Downgrades are unsupported, even within a minor; on a major, update the mobile apps first.

packageRules.description: Longhorn requires sequential minor version upgrades
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Longhorn Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream only supports consecutive minor upgrades and blocks downgrades. Before merging, confirm no volume is `Faulted`, no BackingImage has failed, and the latest Velero backup succeeded. Volume engine upgrades are automated via `concurrentAutomaticEngineUpgradePerNodeLimit` (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#2-automated-storage-engine-upgrades-longhorn)).

packageRules.description: cert-manager recommends sequential minor version upgrades for CRD/webhook alignment
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **cert-manager Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream recommends upgrading minor versions sequentially (e.g. 1.15 → 1.16 → 1.17) to ensure CRD schema and webhook compatibility.

packageRules.description: CloudNativePG operand major upgrades trigger automated in-place pg_upgrade
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **CloudNativePG Upgrade**: Minor versions roll the instance pod. A major PostgreSQL version triggers CloudNativePG's offline in-place `pg_upgrade` Job on sync, with the whole cluster down until it finishes. Before merging a major: take an on-demand CNPG `volumeSnapshot` `Backup` and confirm the extensions and the target image's Debian release match the current one. If the upgrade Job fails, revert this PR. After it succeeds, refresh statistics and take a new backup. See [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#1-automated-major-database-upgrades-cloudnativepg).

packageRules.description: cloudnative-vectorchord tags are <pg major>.<pg minor>-<VectorChord semver>; docker versioning would treat the VectorChord version as a fixed compatibility suffix and never propose an update
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **cloudnative-vectorchord**: Renovate labels VectorChord version changes as patch updates; check the Immich release notes for the supported VectorChord range. The tags do not name the Debian release. On a PostgreSQL major upgrade, compare the `org.opencontainers.image.base.name` label of the new image with the current one: `pg_upgrade` does not support a Debian release change. On a minor update, a Debian release change is safe (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#debian-release-moves)).

packageRules.description: Debian release moves of CloudNativePG operand images keep the PostgreSQL version and never run pg_upgrade
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **CloudNativePG Debian Release Move**: Only the image's Debian release changes; the PostgreSQL version stays the same, so the operator rolls each instance pod and no `pg_upgrade` runs. Every cluster uses CNPG's default `C` collation, which does not depend on glibc, so no reindex is needed. See [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#debian-release-moves).

packageRules.description: MariaDB operand upgrades: separate PRs per major, release-notes reminder
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **MariaDB Upgrade**: Merging is the whole procedure (docs/upgrades.md §8): the Supernote sync first takes a pre-upgrade volume snapshot (PreSync `PhysicalBackup` hook, which fails the sync if the snapshot fails), the instance shuts down cleanly, and the entrypoint runs `mariadb-upgrade` (`mariadbAutoUpgradeEnabled`). Review the [MariaDB release notes](https://mariadb.com/docs/release-notes) for removed or changed options first; MariaDB cannot be downgraded in place.

packageRules.description: Re-vendor the patched DocumentDB operator chart on version bumps so the PR contains the complete tree
Refresh the hass-oidc-auth zip sha256 on version bumps so the PR never ships a stale hash
Refresh the AudioMuse-AI Navidrome plugin sha256 on version bumps so the PR never ships a stale hash
AudioMuse-AI asks to keep the core image and its Navidrome plugin on matching releases: one PR
Codex in the Coder workspace mise.toml: openai/codex tags its releases rust-v<version>, which the mise manager's default ^v? extraction cannot parse
Refresh the mise and rustup-init sha256 hashes in the Coder workspace image on version bumps
Group every Kubernetes version pin (k3s, PSA labels, kind node image, documentation, e2e hook comments) into one PR
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Cluster Upgrade Ordering**: the PSA labels must never reference a Kubernetes minor newer than the API server. Merge a minor bump only once this PR also carries the matching k3s minor (`host/versions.env` and the system-upgrade-controller Plans, which upgrade the nodes in the next 01:00–02:00 Europe/Lisbon window); k3s ships a new minor after upstream Kubernetes does. The e2e suite also requires a local kind CLI new enough to pull the new `kindest/node` image (see docs/upgrades.md).

packageRules.description: Group Cilium Helm chart and CRD tag bumps into one PR so the release and its CRDs stay version-aligned
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Cilium Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream only supports consecutive minor upgrades. Before merging a minor, read its [upgrade notes](https://docs.cilium.io/en/stable/operations/upgrade/) (removed APIs, minimum Gateway API CRD version, which k3s supplies here) and run the [pre-flight check](docs/upgrades.md#cilium-pre-flight-check).

packageRules.description: Grafana VictoriaMetrics datasource plugins: the init container pins each release tarball's sha256, which Renovate cannot compute
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Plugin Checksum**: Renovate moves the release tag and tarball name only. Replace the tarball's `sha256sum -c` value in `apps/grafana/0_grafana.yaml` with the digest from the release assets page before merging, or the plugin-loader init container fails (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#9-upstream-upgrade-procedures)).

packageRules.description: External Secrets recommends sequential minor upgrades
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **External Secrets Upgrade**: Upstream recommends upgrading one minor at a time. Check the [release notes](https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/releases) for removed API versions before merging.

packageRules.description: CloudNativePG operator upgrades roll every PostgreSQL cluster and can carry required steps
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **CloudNativePG Operator Upgrade**: Read the [release notes](https://github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/releases) for required steps; upstream advises against skipping versions. The sync restarts every PostgreSQL cluster once (`instances: 1`).

packageRules.description: MariaDB Operator releases publish per-version upgrade guides
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **MariaDB Operator Upgrade**: Read every `UPGRADE_<version>.md` [guide](https://github.com/mariadb-operator/mariadb-operator/tree/main/docs/releases) up to the target. Prerequisites on the `MariaDB` CR must be committed before the chart bump.

packageRules.description: Velero upgrades step from the previous minor and need a compatible AWS plugin
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Velero Upgrade**: The chart version does not follow Velero's. Check which Velero release this chart ships, read its `upgrade-to-<minor>` guide (upgrades start from the previous minor only), and bump `velero-plugin-for-aws` per its [compatibility matrix](https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero-plugin-for-aws).

packageRules.description: Argo CD minors and majors carry upgrade notes
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **Argo CD Upgrade**: Read the [upgrading notes](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/operator-manual/upgrading/overview/) of every Argo CD minor this chart bump crosses, and the chart README for value changes.

packageRules.description: Group the Coder chart and server image: the chart's appVersion and the pinned image move together
Group every Coder workspace image input (Debian base, mise, rustup, Rust, the mise.toml toolset) into one PR: each merge rebuilds the image once
Coder minors run irreversible database migrations
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **Coder Upgrade**: Read the [release notes](https://github.com/coder/coder/releases) of every minor crossed. Migrations run on startup and cannot be rolled back, so take the CNPG volume-snapshot backup first (docs/upgrades.md §9), then push the repository template again if a provider minimum changed (docs/coder.md).

packageRules.description: AFFiNE minors run irreversible schema and data migrations and can change the config schema
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **AFFiNE Upgrade**: Read the [release notes](https://github.com/toeverything/AFFiNE/releases) of every minor crossed and diff the release's `config.schema.json` against `apps/affine/-1_secrets.yaml` (renamed keys and new BYOK provider values). The init container migrates on startup and cannot be rolled back, so take the CNPG volume-snapshot backup first (docs/upgrades.md §9).

packageRules.description: Woodpecker majors carry required admin actions
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **Woodpecker Upgrade**: Read the [migration notes](https://woodpecker-ci.org/migrations) for every major crossed and apply the listed admin actions after the sync.

packageRules.description: Group the Prometheus Operator CRD tag bumps (repo pin + e2e hook) so the release and its CRDs stay version-aligned
Group the external-snapshotter CRD tag and the snapshot-controller image so the release and its controller stay version-aligned
Group the Envoy Gateway chart and image bumps into one PR
Group every OpenCloud image bump (server, yjs, web extensions) into one PR
OpenCloud majors link a per-major upgrade page with required actions
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **OpenCloud Upgrade**: Follow the release's *Action required* link to the per-major upgrade page (`docs.opencloud.eu/docs/next/admin/maintenance/upgrade/upgrade-<major>.x.x`) and rename the variables and keys `apps/opencloud` sets in this PR. The config patch and search re-index run on startup (docs/upgrades.md §3 and §9).

packageRules.description: The variant-aware regex manager owns the web-extension tags; the kubernetes manager cannot parse variant-prefixed tags
Group the system-upgrade-controller CRD tag, remote base, and image so the release and its CRDs stay version-aligned
Group the VictoriaMetrics single-node and vmalert charts so the query and rule-evaluation sides move together
Group the per-app Valkey chart releases (apps/*/helm/valkey) into one PR so every instance runs the same chart
Group the agents VM tool pins: one PR rebuilds the VM root once in the nightly window
OpenCode and OpenChamber: OpenChamber supports one OpenCode major from a minimum version
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **OpenCode / OpenChamber Upgrade**: OpenChamber runs only on the OpenCode major it targets, from `MINIMUM_OPENCODE_VERSION` in its `packages/web/server/lib/opencode/compatibility.js`. Before merging, confirm the pinned OpenChamber accepts the pinned OpenCode. On an OpenCode major, check the installer URL in `host/agents-vm/provision.sh` and the managed `opencode.json` keys against the [migration guide](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/migrate-v1/) (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#9-upstream-upgrade-procedures)).

packageRules.description: Group the exportarr sidecar across the *arr Deployments so one release lands in a single PR
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **exportarr**: v3 (unreleased at the time of writing) removes `CONFIG` and `ENABLE_ADDITIONAL_METRICS` and changes some metric families; check the release notes and the exportarr-derived dashboards (apps/grafana/dashboards/{prowlarr,sonarr,radarr,lidarr,bazarr}).

packageRules.description: Group the Jellyfin chart and its config-seed init image so they stay on the same Jellyfin release
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Jellyfin Upgrade**: Database migrations are one-way. Read the [Jellyfin release notes](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/releases) and take a Velero backup of the `jellyfin` namespace (scripts/pre-upgrade-backup.sh) before merging a minor.

packageRules.description: Group the Seerr chart and its config-seed init image
Group the Intel GPU device plugin remote base and image
qBittorrent and qbit_manage: qbit_manage refuses qBittorrent releases its pinned qbittorrent-api does not list
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **qBittorrent / qbit_manage**: qbit_manage stops with `UnsupportedVersion` against a qBittorrent release missing from its `SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.json`. Before merging either side, confirm the pinned qbit_manage release lists the pinned qBittorrent version.

packageRules.description: Servarr apps (home-operations images track the develop branch): read the release notes and back up the CNPG cluster before any release that adds a migration
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Servarr Upgrade**: home-operations builds the develop branch. Database migrations are one-way and can ship in any release, patches included: check the upstream compare for new files under `src/NzbDrone.Core/Datastore/Migration`, take a CNPG on-demand `Backup` (docs/upgrades.md) before merging one, and read the release notes for removed settings or environment variables.
